title: 快速模型，缓慢证据：LLM Agent 系统1决策模型的配对自审评估
summary: 该论文对开源（Laya）与托管（Jev）两种系统1决策模型在11个Agent决策点上进行配对评估，涵盖7283个基础案例和6640个鲁棒性变体。Jev在9个决策点上显著更准确，而Laya对选项顺序敏感且候选多时性能骤降。作者还审计了自身流程，发现三处分析错误和一处设计混淆导致部署收益被夸大。
summary_en: This paper presents a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 decision model across 11 agent decision points, using 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 points, while Laya is order-sensitive and degrades sharply with many candidates. The authors also audit their own pipeline, finding three analysis errors and one design confound that distorted headline deployment claims.
